deadline.value: No deadline is stated on the civil and environmental engineering page.

gre_general.value: The engineering college requires GRE scores for all PhD programs.
gre_general.quote: As of February 2024, that includes the: Master's in Computer Engineering Master's in Electrical Engineering all Ph.D programs

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: Applicants need at least one engineering degree from an accredited university, a bachelor's or a master's.
entry_route.quote: Admission to applicants who have at least one degree in engineering from an accredited university and department requires high academic standing in all prior course work.

notes: Students with non-engineering degrees must complete the requirements for a Master of Science in Civil and Environmental Engineering first.
